##Wrap of analysis for multiple samples
#1. Prepare the listing file of input files
```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(vcfR)
library(xml2)
library(XML)
library(MDALL)
options(max.print=1000)
library(data.table)
```


#Combine fusionCatcher original output txt
```{r, echo=FALSE}
setwd("/scratch1/tanxinli/rnaseq_out/FusionCatcher")
all_paths.FusionCatcher <- list.files(path = "/scratch1/tanxinli/rnaseq_out/FusionCatcher", pattern = "*.FusionCatcher",full.names = TRUE)
library(dplyr)

read_file_from_path <- function(folder_path) {
  # Construct the full file path
  file_path <- file.path(folder_path, "final-list_candidate-fusion-genes.txt")
  
  # Check if the file exists
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    stop("File 'mm' does not exist in the specified folder.")
  }
  
  # Read the file (assuming it's a text file, adjust for other file types)
  file_contents <- fread(file_path,header=T)
  
  return(file_contents)
}

# Use lapply to process each file and return the filtered data in a list
all_content.FusionCatcher<- lapply(all_paths.FusionCatcher, read_file_from_path)




library(tidyr)
# read file name
all_filenames <- all_paths.FusionCatcher %>% as.list()
# combine file content list and file name list
all_fc_lists <- mapply(c, all_content.FusionCatcher, all_filenames , SIMPLIFY = FALSE)
# unlist all lists and change column name
all_result <- rbindlist(all_fc_lists, fill = T)
head(all_result)
all_result_updated <- all_result %>%
  separate(V1, c( "junk","sample_name"), sep = "FusionCatcher/") %>% select(-"junk") %>% separate(sample_name, c( "sample","junk"), sep = ".FusionCatcher") %>% select(-"junk")

fwrite(all_result_updated, "/project/desmith_128/recordstudy/rna_seq/allsample_FusionCatcher_output.csv")


```
